job.rawJd:
About the job
Novum Partners is a strategic management firm serving churches, nonprofits, and businesses. We operate across three verticals: Consulting, Finance & Accounting, and HR. Our clients are organizations built for good, and we exist to strategically guide and steward their resources for the good of all humanity.

We are hiring an AI Strategic Lead to lead a new dimension of the firm: building technology products that make Novum indispensable to the organizations we serve, then taking those products to market beyond our existing client base. This is not an IT support role. This is a builder's seat with founder-level upside.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Novum sits inside the operations of over 400 churches, nonprofits, and businesses. We see how they budget, how they manage people, how they make decisions, and where they lose time. That access is rare. What we have not yet done is turn that operational intelligence into technology products that solve problems at scale. That is your job.

You will work directly with the CEO to identify where technology can create leverage, both inside Novum and for the organizations we serve. You will build the tools, refine the products, and implement them. Your compensation is structured so that when those products generate revenue, you share directly in the upside.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
Build internal tools that create operational leverage. Automate workflows, eliminate manual processes, and reduce cost across Novum's three service verticals. You will establish a baseline of current costs and time expenditure, then systematically drive both down.

Design and develop client-facing technology products. Identify problems our 400+ client organizations share, then build tools, platforms, or applications that solve those problems in a way that is scalable, repeatable, and sellable.

Take products to market. You are not just building; we are commercializing. You will work with leadership to price, position, and sell technology products outside of Novum's core service engagements. You own the product from concept through revenue.

Drive AI adoption across the firm. Evaluate, implement, and train the team on AI tools and workflows that raise Novum's capacity without raising headcount. Make the firm smarter, faster, and harder to replicate.

Advise on technology strategy for clients. When a church, nonprofit, or business needs technology guidance, you bring the expertise. This is not implementation support; it is strategic counsel on how technology fits into their operational model.

WHO YOU ARE
You are a builder who ships. You are not interested in strategy decks about what could be built someday. You want to build it, test it, fix it, and get it in front of people who will pay for it. You think in products, not projects.

Technically excellent. You write code, architect systems, and evaluate AI tools with the hands-on depth of someone who has built production software. You are fluent in modern AI/ML tools, API integrations, and no-code/low-code platforms. You can build a prototype in a weekend and a production system in a quarter.

Product-minded. You think about problems from the customer's chair. You can identify the pain point, scope the minimum viable solution, and iterate based on real usage. You know the difference between a feature and a product.

Commercially driven. You care about revenue and value. Building something elegant that nobody buys is a failure. You understand pricing, positioning, and the discipline of finding product-market fit. The commission structure exists because we expect you to think like an owner.

Aligned with the mission. Novum serves organizations built on faith. You do not need to be a theologian, but you need to respect the mission and understand that the people we serve are doing work they believe matters eternally. Posture matters here. Humility, service, and genuine care for these organizations are not optional.

Self-directed. You will report directly to the CEO. There is no product team to manage you, no sprint board someone else maintains, no roadmap handed to you. You will build the roadmap. You need to be the kind of person who thrives with a clear mandate and wide latitude.

WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR
Consultants who advise but do not build
Technologists who build but cannot connect their work to revenue
People who need large teams, long timelines, or perfect conditions before they move
Anyone uncomfortable working inside a faith-based culture or serving churches, nonprofits, and businesses

COMPENSATION
This role is designed for someone who wants to build something and own the outcome. The compensation reflects that.
Salary
Product revenue commission
Production bonus
Benefits include PTO, medical, 401k, and cell phone

ROLE DETAILS
Reports to: CEO
Location: San Antonio, TX preferred; remote considered for the right candidate
Type: Full-time
